summary: AIFU Inc., a Shenzhen-based insurance services group, filed a Form 6-K reporting completion of its acquisition of 100% of Waltz Investment Holding Ltd., which indirectly holds 99% of Shenzhen Waltz New Material Applied Technology, a functional film developer. Total consideration is approximately RMB300.0 million, comprising 11,203,443 Class A ordinary shares priced at US$3.00 each plus US$11,000,000 cash payable to Modern within 365 days of the November 6, 2026 closing. Sellers Ballet, Timber, Modern and Sunrise received 3,546,580, 3,546,580, 2,396,583 and 1,713,700 shares respectively, collectively about 15.48% of 72,379,191 shares outstanding but only 1.03% of voting power, subject to a 60-month lock-up. Shares were issued privately under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S as restricted securities. Watch share overhang after lock-up expiry and deferred cash funding.
